prompt: You should record a video of what will to user once they upgrade to the new release that uses the proxy and what they need to do.
setup: Same CP06.v2 isolated native real application/database, existing synthetic Gmail grant saved under previous integration configuration, actual saved chat/model/Vault/preferences; controlled provider adapters.

UPGRADEUI.pass: Actual native Apps shows retained Gmail requiring sign-in and an available Reconnect action; selecting it shows real app pairing instructions and opens the labelled synthetic consent page.

RECONNECTED.pass: After explicit simulated consent, the real app callback and atomic replacement store one connected Gmail row using the original connection UUID, same email and unchanged watch preference.
RECONNECTED.evidence: Native connected UI plus actual database before/after snapshots and route audit

RETAINED.pass: The original chat, encrypted Vault rows, saved model selection and product/native preferences retain their semantic values.
RETAINED.evidence: Original-row digests, database snapshots and native settings hash

VIDEO.pass: A playable local video visibly demonstrates the upgrade steps and clearly labels provider consent as simulated.
VIDEO.evidence: Produced media, codec inspection and viewing frames

SAFE.pass: No real account or model calls, no production OAuth activation, and no normal-profile user content in the recording.
SAFE.evidence: Evaluator audit, explicit isolated configuration and media review

limits: The real native application and backend replacement are exercised. Temporary hosted page renders synthetic consent only; production broker pairing and actual Google/Composio authorization are not verified by this demonstration.

run_environment.provider: synthetic IntegrationProvider with actual application callback and database replacement
